title: Path to General Relativity & QFT
description: Minimum rigorous mathematical and physical trajectory from multivariable calculus to curved spacetime and quantum fields.

steps.note: Inner products, bilinear forms, and spectral decomposition.
Master Jacobians, differential forms, and Stokes theorem.
Boundary value problems, Green functions, and Sturm-Liouville theory.
Stationary action principle, Euler-Lagrange equations, and Noether theorem.
Covariant electrodynamics and relativistic field strength tensor.
Differentiable manifolds, affine connections, geodesics, and Riemann curvature.
Einstein field equations, Schwarzschild metric, gravitational radiation, and FLRW cosmology.
Hilbert spaces, operators, Schrodinger equation, and harmonic oscillator.
Canonical quantization, Klein-Gordon and Dirac fields, and Feynman diagrams.
